Fixed vim mode `J` joining lines with different spacing than Vim (such as a space before `)` or after a tab), and `3J` or Visual-mode `J` on the last line not moving the cursor as Vim does

title.zh-TW: 沙盒設定個別容錯並防止刪除受保護資料夾
title.en: Sandbox Configuration Adds Granular Fault Tolerance and Prevents Protected Directory Deletion

body.zh-TW: 在沙盒保護與安全限制下執行操作時，系統對檔案權限與設定容錯有了更嚴格的保護。在 Windows 系統中使用 PowerShell 工具時，過去可能透過 `cmd /c rd`、`rmdir`、`del` 或 `erase` 刪除磁碟根目錄、家目錄，以及其他 `Remove-Item` 會拒絕刪除的資料夾；這個漏洞已修復。集中管理的沙盒設定中若有單一巢狀欄位設定錯誤，現在只會封鎖該無效項目，其餘有效的沙盒規則依然會正常套用。在 Git 儲存庫的子目錄啟動時，自動記憶筆記的寫入不會再被誤判為敏感檔案而遭到阻擋，沙盒內的 Git 操作也不會再要求憑證輔助程式（協助 Git 取得或保存登入資訊的小程式）儲存暫時的代理登入資訊。
body.en: File permission safeguards and configuration fault tolerance are strengthened under sandbox protection. When using PowerShell tools on Windows, an issue where `cmd /c rd`, `rmdir`, `del`, or `erase` could bypass protections to delete drive roots, home directories, or folders rejected by `Remove-Item` has been fixed. If centrally managed sandbox settings contain an invalid nested field, only that invalid entry is blocked while all valid sandbox rules continue to apply normally. Launching from subdirectories of a Git repository no longer misidentifies auto-memory note writes as sensitive files, and Git operations inside the sandbox no longer prompt credential helpers to store temporary proxy authentication credentials.

items.original:
Fixed sandboxed `git` asking credential helpers to store the sandbox proxy's login, which printed "failed to store"
Fixed managed `sandbox` settings being ignored entirely when one nested value was invalid; the invalid value now fails closed and the rest of the block still applies
Fixed Claude's edits to its own auto-memory notes being blocked as sensitive-file writes when Claude Code was started in a subdirectory of a git repository
Windows: Fixed the PowerShell tool letting `cmd /c rd`, `rmdir`, `del` or `erase` delete drive roots, the home folder and other folders that `Remove-Item` refuses

title.zh-TW: Git 工作樹修復憑證驗證並優化執行器流程
title.en: Git Worktrees Fix Certificate Verification and Optimize Runner Workflows

body.zh-TW: 使用工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）或自架執行器部署任務時，Git 的憑證與自動化流程更加安全。透過 `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` 環境變數把 CA 憑證（讓電腦確認伺服器身分的憑證）交給 Git 時，工作樹檢出不會再因憑證驗證失敗而中斷，例如下載 Git LFS 檔案時。在自架執行器環境中，生命週期掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）執行 Git 指令時會略過儲存庫的 Git LFS `pre-push` 掛鉤，並忽略系統層級的可寫掛鉤路徑；若未使用 `--configure-git`，也不再簽署提交。執行器自己的 Git 現在一律驗證通往 Anthropic Git 的路由，警告訊息也會說清楚 `GIT_SSL_CAINFO` 與 `GIT_SSL_NO_VERIFY` 各自在哪裡生效。
body.en: When deploying tasks with worktrees or self-hosted runners, Git credentials and automation workflows are safer. Passing CA certificates to Git through the `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` environment variable no longer interrupts worktree checkouts due to certificate verification failures, such as when downloading Git LFS files. In self-hosted runner environments, lifecycle hooks executing Git commands skip repository Git LFS `pre-push` hooks and ignore system-level writable hook paths; they also no longer sign commits if `--configure-git` is not used. The runner's own Git now consistently verifies routes to Anthropic Git, and warning messages clearly state where `GIT_SSL_CAINFO` and `GIT_SSL_NO_VERIFY` take effect.

items.original:
Fixed worktree checkouts failing certificate verification (for example on Git LFS downloads) when the CA certificate is passed to git as `GIT_CONFIG_COUNT` environment pairs
Self-hosted runner: Changed lifecycle hooks' git to skip a repository's Git LFS `pre-push` hook, ignore a writable system `core.hooksPath`, and not sign commits without `--configure-git`
Self-hosted runner: Changed `GIT_SSL_CAINFO` and `GIT_SSL_NO_VERIFY` under Anthropic-managed git: the runner's own git always verifies Anthropic's git route, and warning lines say what applies where

title.zh-TW: 模型備援重試原設定並修復額度顯示
title.en: Model Fallback Retries Original Configuration and Fixes Quota Display

body.zh-TW: 切換模型或查詢使用額度時，顯示資訊與備援機制更為精確。在停用遙測的情況下，每週 Fable 額度（可用資源的配額上限）現在會正確顯示於 `/usage` 與 VS Code 用量儀表中。使用 `/model` 時，Sonnet 4.6 或 Sonnet 5 的模型 ID 若帶日期或 `-v1:0` 後綴，不會再錯誤接受本應拒絕的 `[1m]` 選項；指定預設 Haiku 模型時，也會正確顯示對應型號與價格。在 Opus 已有 1M 上下文視窗時，Opus 選項及 Default 模型名稱不再顯示「(1M context)」，實際視窗大小不變。發生模型備援（改用替代模型）時，動態工作流程不會再將所有子代理鎖在備用模型，而會重試原先設定的模型；若 Haiku 是工作階段主要模型，`DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_HAIKU` 也能生效。
body.en: When switching models or checking usage quotas, displayed information and fallback mechanisms are more accurate. With telemetry disabled, weekly Fable quotas now display correctly in `/usage` and the VS Code usage meter. When using `/model`, model IDs for Sonnet 4.6 or Sonnet 5 with dates or `-v1:0` suffixes no longer incorrectly accept the `[1m]` option that should be rejected, and specifying the default Haiku model correctly displays the corresponding model version and pricing. When Opus already has a 1M context window, Opus options and the Default model name no longer display "(1M context)", while the actual window size remains unchanged. When model fallback occurs, dynamic workflows no longer lock all subagents onto the fallback model and instead retry the originally configured model. If Haiku is the primary session model, `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_HAIKU` also takes effect.

items.original:
Fixed the weekly Fable limit not appearing in `/usage` and the VS Code usage meters when telemetry is disabled
Fixed `/model` accepting Sonnet 4.6 or Sonnet 5 with `[1m]` when the id carried a date or `-v1:0` suffix, in the cases where the plain id was refused
Fixed `/model` picker showing a hardcoded Haiku version and price when `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL` pins a different model
Fixed dynamic workflows started during a model fallback running every agent on the fallback model instead of retrying the configured model
Fixed `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_HAIKU` having no effect when Haiku is the session's main model
Changed the `/model` picker's Opus row and the Default model's name to drop "(1M context)" where Opus already has a 1M context window; the window is unchanged

title.zh-TW: 連線預熱降低延遲並延遲載入啟動模組
title.en: Connection Warmup Reduces Latency and Startup Modules Load Lazily

body.zh-TW: 啟動對話與發送第一次提問時，等待時間明顯縮短。透過重複使用預先建立的連線，首次發出請求的延遲明顯降低；工作階段首次回覆生成時，也會同步執行模式編譯步驟，不必等到串流結束才處理。使用 `claude -p` 或 Claude Code Remote 時，程式不會再預先載入無用的互動介面，規則分類器與成品工具也改為首次使用時才延遲載入。首次使用、Artifact 功能尚未確認的 claude.ai 帳號，提示階段不再等待最多 1.5 秒；必要時改由首則訊息等待。成品資料庫的排序查詢傳回滿一頁時，會說明這只是其中一頁，以及如何讀取後續內容。自動啟動的成品監看在閒置三個半小時後會關閉；發布成品或再次監看時會重新啟動。
body.en: When starting conversations and sending the first prompt, wait times are noticeably shorter. Reusing pre-established connections significantly reduces first-request latency, and the compilation step runs concurrently during initial response generation rather than waiting until streaming ends. When using `claude -p` or Claude Code Remote, unnecessary interactive interfaces are no longer preloaded, and rule classifiers and artifact tools now load lazily on first use. For first-time claude.ai accounts where artifact features are unconfirmed, prompting no longer waits up to 1.5 seconds, deferring the wait to the first message if necessary. When sorted artifact database queries return a full page, they clarify that this is only one page and explain how to retrieve subsequent items. Automatically started artifact watchers shut down after three and a half hours of inactivity, restarting when artifacts are published or watched again.

items.original:
Improved artifact database reads: an ordered query that returns a full page now says it is one page and how to read the rest
Improved first-reply latency: a pattern-compile step that ran at the end of a session's first reply now runs while the reply streams in
Improved first-request latency by reusing the preconnected API connection
Improved startup: `claude -p` and Claude Code Remote no longer load the interactive UI, and the auto-mode classifier's rules and the Artifact tool load on first use instead of at launch
Improved startup for claude.ai accounts whose Artifact tool features aren't known yet, as on a first run: the prompt no longer waits up to 1.5 s to check them; the first message waits if needed
Changed artifact watching: a watch that was armed automatically (not one you asked for) now ends after 3.5 hours with no activity; publishing or watching the artifact again re-arms it

title.zh-TW: 遠端控制支援無遙測並即時顯示壓縮字數
title.en: Remote Control Supports Telemetry-Free Mode and Displays Live Compaction Tokens

body.zh-TW: 使用遠端控制功能或等待長對話進行背景壓縮時，畫面顯示更清楚流暢。付費方案使用者透過 `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` 或 `DO_NOT_TRACK` 關閉遙測回報時，遠端控制功能現在仍能正常啟用；在較窄的終端機視窗中執行 `/remote-control` 時，行動裝置掃描提示也不會再發生文字換行截斷。當對話過長觸發上下文壓縮時，等待圖示會在壓縮開始時啟動計時器，並以動態計數顯示生成摘要所消耗的文字單位（token，AI 處理與計費的文字單位），取代舊有的固定百分比進度條。
body.en: When using remote control or waiting for long sessions to undergo background context compaction, displays are clearer and smoother. Paid plan users disabling telemetry via `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` or `DO_NOT_TRACK` can now still enable remote control normally, and running `/remote-control` in narrower terminal windows no longer truncates mobile QR scanning prompts with awkward line wraps. When overly long conversations trigger context compaction, the spinner starts a timer at compaction onset and dynamically counts tokens consumed during summary generation, replacing the previous static percentage progress bar.

items.original:
Fixed Remote Control being unavailable on paid plans when telemetry is turned off with `DISABLE_TELEMETRY` or `DO_NOT_TRACK`
Fixed the `/remote-control` menu cutting its QR-code hint mid-word in narrow terminals
Improved the compaction spinner: its timer now starts when compaction begins and it counts the summary's tokens as they stream, replacing the percentage bar

title.zh-TW: 系統提示詞支援檔案混用並解除技能命名限制
title.en: System Prompts Support Mixed Files and Skill Naming Limits Are Lifted

body.zh-TW: 自訂系統提示詞與管理技能權限規則時，設定方式變得更加靈活。在啟動參數中，`--system-prompt` 與 `--append-system-prompt` 現在允許同時傳入文字內容與檔案參數，檔案內的提示文字會自動排在文字參數之前。`Skill(anthropic-skills:<name>)` 禁用規則現在也會封鎖由 Claude Desktop 以外掛形式傳遞的該技能；`Skill(skill:<name>)` 禁用規則則會比對技能的別名與顯示名稱。先前版本對 `claude-ai` 名稱的保留限制已撤回：同名的技能、指令、工作流程，以及 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器中的技能與提示詞，都能重新載入；`Skill(claude-ai:*)` 仍按一般前綴規則運作。
body.en: When customizing system prompts and managing skill permission rules, configuration is more flexible. In launch flags, `--system-prompt` and `--append-system-prompt` now permit passing both inline text and file arguments simultaneously, placing file prompt contents before text arguments automatically. `Skill(anthropic-skills:<name>)` disable rules now also block that skill when delivered as an extension by Claude Desktop, while `Skill(skill:<name>)` disable rules match against skill aliases and display names. Prior reserved name restrictions on `claude-ai` have been lifted: identically named skills, commands, workflows, and MCP server skills and prompts can all be reloaded, while `Skill(claude-ai:*)` continues to operate under standard prefix rules.

items.original:
Changed `--system-prompt` and `--append-system-prompt` to accept their text and `-file` forms together; the file's text comes first
Changed `Skill(anthropic-skills:<name>)` deny rules to also block that skill when Claude Desktop delivers it as a plugin, and `Skill(skill:<name>)` denies to match the skill's alias and display name
Reverted the 2.1.282 reservation of the `claude-ai` name: skills, commands, workflows and MCP servers' skills and prompts so named load again, and `Skill(claude-ai:*)` rules are ordinary prefix rules

title.zh-TW: 第三方平台預設開啟自動模式並補齊審查提示
title.en: Third-Party Platforms Default to Auto Mode and Review Prompts Add Warnings

body.zh-TW: 透過第三方雲端平台操作或執行自動化工作流程時，預設權限與狀態保留有了調整。在未特別設定權限模式的情況下，使用第三方平台或關閉遙測的互動對話現在預設會直接進入自動模式，使用者依然能透過設定覆蓋此預設行為。執行 `/ultrareview` 程式碼審查前，啟動視窗會提醒審查本地分支可能上傳已追蹤檔案中未提交的變更。在無障礙環境下，螢幕閱讀器不會再將引述的指令與路徑誤讀為對話框內建文字。軟體開發套件的回合提早結束時，不再遺失延後執行的工具呼叫或已完成的結果；背景工作單元重啟後，待核准提示也不再遺失。非串流備援的用量資訊同樣會保留。
body.en: When operating through third-party cloud platforms or executing automated workflows, default permissions and state retention are refined. Without explicitly configured permission modes, interactive sessions on third-party platforms or with telemetry disabled now default directly to auto mode, though users can still override this default via settings. Before launching `/ultrareview` code reviews, the startup prompt warns that reviewing local branches may upload uncommitted changes from tracked files. In accessible environments, screen readers no longer misread quoted commands and paths as built-in dialog text. When SDK turns end early, deferred tool calls or completed results are no longer lost, and pending approval prompts are preserved across background worker restarts. Usage information for non-streaming fallbacks is likewise retained.

items.original:
Fixed SDK sessions losing a deferred tool call or finished tool result when a turn ended early, a held approval prompt after a worker restart, and a non-streaming fallback's `result.usage`
Fixed permission dialogs in screen-reader mode reading quoted commands and paths as if they were the dialog's own text
Changed interactive sessions on third-party providers or with telemetry off to start in auto mode when no permission mode is configured; `permissions.defaultMode` still overrides it
Changed the `/ultrareview` launch dialog to say that reviewing a local branch may upload uncommitted changes to tracked files

title.zh-TW: VS Code 修復網頁對話同步與介面輸入偏移
title.en: VS Code Fixes Web Session Sync and Input Field Cursor Misalignment

body.zh-TW: 在編輯器中接續跨平台工作階段（使用者與 AI 進行的一輪連續對話歷程）或貼上長篇提示詞時，操作更加順暢。從網頁版傳送至 VS Code 的工作階段，現在不會再遺失 Claude 工作期間送出的訊息；舊版留下空白本機副本時，網頁工作階段也不會從清單消失並開出空白對話。重新開啟工作階段後，若 Claude 在回合中途收到訊息（例如自動接續），該回合也不會再被錯誤拆開。重新載入後，也不會再顯示已倒回移除的回合，或在壓縮後只顯示壓縮前的訊息。當權限模式自動切換失敗時，切換會持續重試直到成功，不再讓指示器顯示與實際模式不符。窄面板中的代理圖示位置，以及在長提示詞中貼上以換行結尾的多行文字時，輸入框文字與游標偏離的問題，現在也全都獲得解決。
body.en: Resuming cross-platform sessions in the editor or pasting long prompts is now much smoother. Sessions sent from the web app to VS Code no longer drop messages sent while Claude is working, nor do web sessions vanish from the list and open empty chats when older versions leave blank local copies behind. After reopening sessions, turns are no longer split incorrectly if Claude receives a message mid-turn (such as during auto-continue). Reloading also no longer displays rewound turns or shows only pre-compaction messages after compaction. When automatic permission mode switching fails, the switch continually retries until it succeeds, preventing the indicator from showing a mismatch with the active mode. Agent icon alignment in narrow panels and cursor drift when pasting multiline text ending with newlines into long prompts have also both been resolved.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the permission mode indicator showing Default while the session kept running in auto or bypass mode after an automatic switch out of it failed; the switch is now retried until it lands
[VSCode] Fixed a session teleported from the web dropping the messages sent while Claude was working
[VSCode] Fixed a Web session staying hidden from the session list, and an empty chat opening in its place, when an older version had saved an empty local copy of it
[VSCode] Fixed a reopened session splitting a turn at a message Claude received mid-turn, such as an automatic continuation
[VSCode] Fixed a reloaded session showing a rewound-away turn, or only the rows before a compaction
[VSCode] Fixed the footer's agents pill drawing its icon off-center, with the status dot against the edge, in narrow panels
[VSCode] Fixed the chat input showing its text slightly below the cursor and selection after pasting lines that end with a line break into a long prompt

title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段支援唯讀倉庫並防止重複執行步驟
title.en: Cloud Sessions Support Read-Only Repositories and Prevent Duplicate Steps

body.zh-TW: 在雲端環境執行背景任務與排程時，多儲存庫整合與重啟穩定度獲得改善。現在將私有程式碼倉庫加入執行中的雲端工作階段時，只要 GitHub 帳號擁有讀取權限，就能加入供讀取，不再強制要求推送權限。當伺服器端發生重啟並自動復原時，系統不會再重複執行已經完成的步驟，避免送出重複的留言或推送。在雲端建立新的例行排程時，預設執行時間會設在整點過後幾分鐘；畫面也會提示，設在整點的排程可能晚幾分鐘啟動。對話開頭幾字在雲端環境中也能順暢串流顯示。
body.en: When running background tasks and schedules in cloud environments, multi-repo integration and restart stability are improved. Adding private repositories to running cloud sessions now only requires read permissions on the GitHub account rather than forcing push access. When server restarts trigger automatic recovery, completed steps are no longer re-executed, preventing duplicate comments or pushes. When creating new recurring schedules in the cloud, default execution times are set a few minutes past the hour, and the UI notes that schedules set on the hour may start a few minutes late. Initial conversational words also stream smoothly in cloud environments.

items.original:
Fixed the first words of a reply in a cloud session sometimes appearing late instead of streaming as Claude writes them
[Cloud sessions] Improved adding a repository to a running cloud session: a private repository your GitHub account can read but not push to now attaches for reading
[Cloud sessions] Fixed cloud sessions occasionally redoing an already-finished step, such as posting a duplicate comment or push, after recovering from a server-side restart
[Cloud sessions] Changed new routine schedules to default to a few minutes past the hour, with a note that routines set exactly on the hour can start several minutes late

title.zh-TW: Slack 標記支援限制頻道搜尋並修復重複回覆
title.en: Slack Mentions Support Restricted Channel Searches and Fix Duplicate Replies

body.zh-TW: 在企業通訊軟體 Slack 中透過標記呼叫 Claude 時，管理權限與連線設定更為完善。管理員現在可按組織、工作區或頻道設定搜尋限制，僅准許 Claude 搜尋已被加入的公開頻道；完成帳號授權後也新增了返回按鈕直接跳回對話串。針對透過規則綁定權限的頻道，設定頁面現在會正確顯示所有已啟用的外掛與連接器；若 GitHub App 安裝只選取了大量儲存庫，搜尋也不再遺漏項目。當回應途中收到新訊息時，系統不會再重複發送兩次答案。舊私人頻道識別碼變更後，排程不再停止；設為 `Channel only` 的頻道中，非訪客成員加入而 Slack 延遲確認身分時，也不會再讓所有對話中斷。
body.en: When invoking Claude via mentions in Slack, permission management and connection settings are more comprehensive. Administrators can now configure search restrictions by organization, workspace, or channel, allowing Claude to search only added public channels, while a new back button returns directly to the thread after completing account authorization. For channels with rule-bound permissions, settings pages now correctly show all active extensions and connectors, and searches no longer miss items when a GitHub App installation selects a large number of repositories. When new messages arrive mid-response, the system no longer sends duplicate answers. Schedules no longer stop when legacy private channel IDs change, and non-guest members joining channels configured as `Channel only` no longer interrupt all conversations when Slack delays identity confirmation.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Added a "Channels Claude can search" admin setting that limits Claude's Slack search to public channels it has been added to, set per organization, workspace or channel
[Claude Tag] Added a Back to Slack button on the page shown after connecting your Claude account, returning you to the thread you started from
[Claude Tag] Fixed a channel's configure page listing no connectors or plugins when the channel gets its access bundle through an attach rule; rule-attached bundles are now shown
[Claude Tag] Fixed access-bundle repository search missing repositories on GitHub App installs that are limited to a large list of selected repositories
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude occasionally posting the same reply twice when a new message interrupted it mid-reply
[Claude Tag] Fixed channel routines that stopped running in older private channels whose Slack channel ID changed, for example after a Slack Connect share
[Claude Tag] Fixed conversations in a channel set to "Channel only" all ending when a non-guest member joined and Slack was slow to confirm their membership

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查請求自動重試，逾時未驗證免收費
title.en: Code Review Requests Auto-Retry, Waiving Charges for Unverified Timeouts

body.zh-TW: 在 GitHub 送交分支變更並呼叫 `@claude review` 協助檢查時，請求失敗或逾時中斷不再毫無回應。當 GitHub 未能回傳 PR（pull request，請求合併程式碼）時，審查請求會重試一次；若仍失敗，就會留言說明。如果程式碼審查因達到時間上限而被迫中止且尚未完成任何驗證，該次審查會標記為未完成狀態且不會扣除費用，並會自動重試一次。⟦送出快遞訂單後，如果查不到訂單，平台會再查一次，仍查不到就留言告知；如果配送逾時，而且連一件貨都還沒查驗，才會標記未完成、免收費並再試一次。⟧
body.en: When submitting branch changes on GitHub and invoking `@claude review` for assistance, failed requests or timeout interruptions no longer stall without a response. When GitHub fails to return a pull request, the review request retries once; if it fails again, it posts an explanatory comment. If a code review is aborted due to reaching its time limit without completing any verification, the review is marked incomplete, incurs no charge, and automatically retries once. ⟦When placing a courier delivery, if the system cannot locate the order, it checks once more and leaves a message if still unfound; if delivery times out before any package is verified, it is marked incomplete at no charge and retried once.⟧

items.original:
[Code Review] Fixed "@claude review" requests going silent when GitHub failed to return the pull request: the request is retried once, and a comment explains if it still fails
[Code Review] Fixed billing for a review that stopped at its time limit with nothing verified: it now shows as incomplete, isn't charged, and is retried once

title.zh-TW: Windows 執行背景與沙盒指令不再跳出黑視窗閃爍
title.en: Background and Sandboxed Commands on Windows No Longer Flash Black Windows

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上使用 Codex 處理專案時，工作節奏不再會被突如其來的畫面閃爍打斷。以前每當它在幕後啟動背景行程（在後台運作而不佔用畫面的程式）時，螢幕常會瞬間閃現黑框。執行沙盒指令（被限制在安全隔離環境中執行的指令）時也會出現同樣的彈窗干擾。現在 Codex 啟動這些背景任務時，跳出主控台（console，顯示純文字指令的介面）視窗的閃爍問題已經被修好。⟦像舞台助理在布幕後方安靜搬運道具，不會每次走動就突然拉開簾子干擾台前的表演。⟧
body.en: When working on projects with Codex on Windows, your workflow is no longer interrupted by sudden screen flashing. Previously, whenever it spawned background processes behind the scenes, black command prompt windows would often flash across the screen. Running sandboxed commands caused the same popup disruptions. Now, the flashing issue caused by popup console windows when Codex launches these background tasks has been fixed. ⟦Picture a stage assistant moving props quietly behind the curtains without pulling them open to disrupt the performance on stage every time they move around.⟧

items.original: Suppressed console windows flashing on Windows when Codex launches background processes and sandboxed commands. (#49385)

title.zh-TW: 預設模型升級為 GPT-6.1 Sol
title.en: Default Model Upgraded to GPT-6.1 Sol

body.zh-TW: 你想知道 Codex 預設選哪個模型時，可以看它使用的模型目錄。這次改動涵蓋三份目錄：Codex 內建的模型目錄，以及 Amazon Bedrock（亞馬遜的雲端 AI 服務）中名為 Mantle 和 Runtime 的兩份模型目錄。三份目錄現在都把 GPT-6.1 Sol 列為預設模型。⟦像三份菜單原本各有預設餐點，現在都把預設欄改填同一道餐；改的是菜單上的預設選項。⟧
body.en: When checking which model Codex selects by default, you can look at the model catalog it references. This update covers three catalogs: Codex's built-in model catalog, and two model catalogs named Mantle and Runtime in Amazon Bedrock (Amazon's cloud AI service). All three catalogs now list GPT-6.1 Sol as the default model. ⟦Picture three menus that each previously had a default meal, now all updated to list the same dish as the default; what changed is the preset option printed on each menu.⟧

items.original: Added GPT-6.1 Sol as the default model in the bundled catalog and Amazon Bedrock Mantle and Runtime catalogs. (#49323, #49342)

title.zh-TW: 隨時插話調整方向，即時引導執行中的任務
title.en: Steer Active Tasks in Real Time with Instant Interrupts

body.zh-TW: 當你看著模型正洋洋灑灑回答、或是執行耗時的程式呼叫時，只要打字就能立刻把它的思緒拉回新方向。啟用 `instant_interrupt` 設定後，你不必苦等當前輸出跑完或強行中斷重來，送出新提示詞就能在運算當下直接引導 Codex 調整下一步。⟦好比向正在報告的助理隨時遞上補充紙條，對方能邊聽邊改口，不用等整場簡報講完才重新開會。⟧如果你發現剛才的提問有誤或想臨時補充細節，這項機制讓你隨時插話，省去反覆等待與重啟對話的時間。
body.en: When you watch the model outputting a lengthy response or running a time-consuming program call, you can steer its train of thought in a new direction simply by typing. After enabling the `instant_interrupt` setting, you do not have to wait for the current output to finish or forcefully interrupt and start over; sending a new prompt directly guides Codex to adjust its next step mid-computation. ⟦Think of handing a supplementary note to an assistant mid-presentation, allowing them to adjust what they are saying on the fly instead of waiting for the meeting to end.⟧ If you spot a mistake in your previous prompt or want to add details spontaneously, this mechanism lets you chime in at any time, saving you the wait of restarting conversations.

items.original: Opt-in `instant_interrupt` lets new input steer Codex during model responses or long-running code-mode calls. (#48135, #48141)

title.zh-TW: 切換任務保留未送出草稿，全新對話即刻歸檔
title.en: Preserve Unsent Drafts Across Tasks and Archive Empty Sessions

body.zh-TW: 在打了一長串提示詞卻臨時想切去處理別的工作時，留在輸入框的草稿現在不會無故消失。就算當前是一個尚未展開對話的全新空白工作階段（session，開啟工具後與 AI 互動的獨立工作階段），切換任務時輸入內容依然會妥善保留。同時，你還沒送出第一則訊息的對話串，現在也能直接列在清單中或執行歸檔。⟦彷彿隨手在便條本寫了點想法還沒撕下，就算臨時翻到其他頁面工作，回頭時剛才的草稿與空白筆記本依然整齊收在抽屜裡。⟧這讓你在整理多個進行中的任務時，不必擔心手滑切換而弄丟寫到一半的想法。
body.en: When you type out a lengthy prompt but suddenly need to switch to another task, the draft in the input box no longer disappears. Even if the current task is a brand-new blank session without any messages yet, your entered input is properly preserved when switching tasks. In addition, conversation threads where you have not sent a first message can now be listed directly or archived. ⟦Picture jotting down thoughts on a notepad without tearing off the sheet; even if you flip to other pages to work, your draft and blank notebook remain neatly tucked in your drawer when you return.⟧ This ensures you will not lose half-written ideas when switching between multiple active tasks.

items.original: Blank sessions retain drafts when switching tasks, and threads can be archived and listed before their first turn. (#48628, #48828, #48199)

title.zh-TW: 終端介面精簡俐落，審核計畫與警告檢視更順手
title.en: Streamlined Terminal Interface with Flexible Plan Review and Warning Inspection

body.zh-TW: 當你開啟新的工作階段時，終端機現在會以更精簡的歡迎畫面與統一標頭迎接你，並在對話進行中或結束後適時提供操作小提示。如果在執行時跳出警告檢視器，關閉檢視器時會自動清除已看過的警告項目，若有想稍後再確認的重點，只要按下鍵盤上的 `k` 鍵就能特意保留。此外，當 Codex 提出執行計畫並詢問是否採用時，你不再被卡在固定的確認畫面，而是能自由向上捲動對話記錄，仔細核對先前的上下文再做決定。這些調整讓你在終端機裡查閱與操作時更加直覺流暢。
body.en: When you start a new session, the terminal greets you with a cleaner welcome screen and unified header, offering helpful tips during or after conversations. If the warning viewer appears during execution, closing it automatically clears reviewed warnings, though you can press the `k` key to keep specific items for later review. Furthermore, when Codex presents an execution plan and asks for confirmation, you are no longer stuck on a rigid confirmation screen; instead, you can freely scroll up through conversation history to check prior context before deciding. These adjustments make reviewing and interacting in the terminal more intuitive and fluid.

items.original:
New sessions get a compact welcome screen and consistent headers, with occasional tips during and after turns. (#48513, #48562, #48352)
The warnings viewer dismisses reviewed warnings when closed; press `k` to keep one for later. (#48205, #48206)
You can scroll the transcript while deciding whether to implement a plan. (#48805)

title.zh-TW: 完整繪製流程圖節點，反白複製保留表格排版
title.en: Render Rich Flowchart Nodes and Copy Terminal Tables with Intact Layouts

body.zh-TW: 當你請 AI 繪製架構圖或整理資料表格時，畫面呈現與複製貼上的格式現在更加精準。內建的 Mermaid（用純文字繪製圖表的語法）渲染器現在支援更多流程圖連線樣式、文字標籤與節點群組，排版不再輕易破版。同時，在終端機選取並複製對話記錄時，會完整保留 Markdown 表格結構、文字樣式與縮排空白，且支援更多終端機的反白即複製功能。⟦像開會時一邊看白板圖、一邊複製會議筆記：以前白板難以畫出某些連線、標籤和分組，貼出的筆記也可能亂掉；現在白板能畫得更完整，筆記的表格與縮排也能留住。⟧你不再需要手動補齊歪掉的欄位或重畫群組架構。
body.en: When asking AI to generate architecture diagrams or data tables, rendering and copy-pasting formats are now significantly more accurate. The built-in Mermaid renderer supports more flowchart link styles, text labels, and node subgraphs, making layouts less prone to breaking. Meanwhile, selecting and copying conversation logs in the terminal fully preserves Markdown table structures, text styles, and indentation spacing, with broader support for copy-on-select terminal behaviors. ⟦Like reviewing a whiteboard diagram while copying meeting notes: previously, certain links, labels, and groups failed to draw on the board, and pasted notes lost their format; now the whiteboard renders fully, and table columns and indentation stay intact.⟧ You no longer need to manually realign misaligned columns or redraw node groups.

items.original:
Native Mermaid rendering supports more flowchart edges, labels, and node groups. (#48814, #48895)
Copying transcript selections preserves Markdown tables, formatting, and significant whitespace. More terminals now copy automatically on selection. (#48548, #48549, #48469)

title.zh-TW: 本機登入瀏覽器穩定開啟，提供快捷鍵複製連結
title.en: Reliable Browser Launch for Local Login with Shortcut to Copy Links

body.zh-TW: 剛安裝好工具準備登入帳號時，驗證步驟變得更加順暢可靠。透過本機登入 ChatGPT 帳號時，系統現在能穩定自動開啟預設瀏覽器完成授權；如果瀏覽器未能如期跳出，初次引導畫面也額外提供了快捷鍵，可以直接複製登入網址並手動貼到瀏覽器開啟。⟦如同收到電子邀請函時能直接點擊連結前往會場，信件下方也貼心附上備用網址供你隨時手動複製。⟧這避免了過去登入視窗偶爾卡住、使用者找不到授權網址而卡在開場說明的窘境。
body.en: When logging into your account after installing the tool, the authentication workflow is much smoother and more dependable. When logging into a ChatGPT account locally, the system reliably opens your default browser to complete authorization; if the browser fails to pop up, the onboarding screen provides a keyboard shortcut to directly copy the login URL and paste it manually. ⟦A guest receiving an invitation can click the link directly to enter, with a backup URL included at the bottom for manual copying.⟧ This avoids past issues where login windows hung or users got stuck without an authorization URL during onboarding.

items.original: Local ChatGPT sign-in opens the browser reliably; onboarding also provides a shortcut to copy the login link. (#48502, #48544)

title.zh-TW: 檔案拒絕存取規則持續生效，修復 macOS 沙盒網路
title.en: Enforce File Access Restrictions on Approved Commands and Fix macOS Sandbox Networking

body.zh-TW: 即使你已經核准了某些指令的執行權限，安全防線依然不會被整組打破。現在已核准的指令仍會嚴格遵循你明確設定的檔案系統存取限制，且在可寫入根目錄底下的 `.aws`（儲存雲端服務金鑰的資料夾）目錄預設會受到保護，防止機密憑證外洩。此外，在 macOS 上啟用網路連線的沙盒與需要代理伺服器的遠端環境中，先前 TLS（安全傳輸層協定，用於加密網路連線）連線異常的問題也已經修好。⟦就像拿到大樓通行證的訪客依然進不去被特別上鎖的機房，隔離會議室內的專用電話也能順暢撥通對外連線。⟧過去在受限環境中可能連不上網路或不小心動到機密檔案的情況，現在都能正常防護並穩定連線。
body.en: Even after approving execution permissions for specific commands, your security boundaries remain intact. Approved commands now strictly adhere to your explicitly configured filesystem access restrictions, and the `.aws` directory under writable roots is protected by default to prevent secret credential leaks. In addition, on macOS sandboxes with networking enabled and in proxy-reliant remote environments, prior TLS connection anomalies have been resolved. ⟦Just as a visitor with a building pass cannot enter locked server rooms, a dedicated telephone in an isolated meeting room can still reliably make outside calls.⟧ Situations where network connections failed in restricted environments or secret files were unintentionally touched are now properly protected with stable connections.

items.original:
Approved commands retain explicit filesystem denials, and `.aws` directories are protected by default under writable roots. (#48155, #48176)
Fixed macOS TLS access in network-enabled sandboxes and remote environments that require proxy access. (#48565, #48198)

title.zh-TW: Windows 啟動不再跳出黑視窗，歷史記錄支援分頁讀取
title.en: Suppress Pop-up Console Windows on Windows and Support Paginated History

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 系統上啟動工具時，桌面不再被突然彈出的黑色視窗打擾。執行 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器、程式模式主機或管道指令時，能避免跳出多餘的主控台視窗，且在權限受限的啟動環境下會自動切換為內嵌備援模式。同時，應用伺服器（app-server，負責處理外部用戶端請求的後端服務）現在支援分頁讀取功能，用戶端能指定從特定的對話項目開始拉取歷史記錄。⟦跟把後台運作的設備狀態收納在櫃子裡一樣，既不佔用走道視線，要調閱舊帳冊時也能直接翻開指定頁碼。⟧這讓你在 Windows 上的多工體驗更加乾淨整潔。
body.en: When launching tools on Windows, your desktop is no longer disrupted by sudden black terminal pop-ups. Spawning MCP servers, programmatic mode hosts, or piped commands avoids extraneous console windows, and the system automatically falls back to an embedded mode in permission-restricted launch environments. Meanwhile, the app-server now supports pagination, allowing clients to fetch history starting from a specific conversation item. ⟦Storing operating background machinery inside a utility closet keeps hallways clear of clutter, while pulling old ledgers lets you flip directly to the desired page.⟧ This makes multitasking on Windows cleaner and more organized.

items.original:
App-server clients can paginate thread history from a specific item. (#48151)
Windows launches avoid stray console windows for MCP servers, code-mode hosts, and piped commands; restrictive launchers can fall back to embedded mode. (#48138, #48238, #48483, #48491)

title.zh-TW: 移除自動追問建議，精簡內建外掛製作技能
title.en: Remove Automatic Prompt Suggestions and Streamline Built-in Plugin Creator Skill

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣自己在終端機掌握對話節奏，畫面現在不會再主動彈出干擾思考的後續問題建議。這次更新正式移除了自動追問提示建議功能，相關的 `tui.prompt_suggestions` 設定項也一併清理下架。同時，系統不再預先打包隨附的 `plugin-creator`（外掛製作工具）技能，讓內建環境回歸輕量。⟦跟整理工作桌一樣，移開以前容易干擾視線的提示便條與預載雜物，檯面重新回到乾淨專注的狀態。⟧以前畫面上可能會出現用不到的建議或預載工具，現在介面與設定檔都變得更加清爽，把主導權完全交還給你的指令。
body.en: If you prefer managing your conversation flow in the terminal yourself, the screen will no longer pop up follow-up prompt suggestions that interrupt your train of thought. This update officially removes automated follow-up prompt suggestions and retires the corresponding `tui.prompt_suggestions` setting. In addition, the system no longer bundles the built-in `plugin-creator` skill out of the box, keeping the default environment lightweight. ⟦Clearing clutter from a workbench removes distracting sticky notes and preloaded accessories, restoring the workspace to a clean and focused state.⟧ Where unused suggestions or preloaded tools once cluttered the view, the interface and configuration are now cleaner, handing full control back to your commands.

items.original:
Removed automatic follow-up prompt suggestions and the `tui.prompt_suggestions` setting. (#48621)
Removed the bundled `plugin-creator` skill. (#48604)

title.zh-TW: 設定選單新增排隊選項，可隨時插話打斷對話
title.en: Settings Menu Adds Queue Option to Interrupt Conversations Anytime

body.zh-TW:
當你看到助理正朝錯誤方向執行長任務時，現在可以直接插話叫停。⟦跟看著助手搬錯箱子時直接出聲喊停一樣，以前只能等他把整批貨搬完才能交代新指令，現在一開口就能立刻打斷他。⟧你可以在 `/config` 選單找到 `Queued Messages` 選項。保持預設的 `Queue` 會把補充訊息暫存到當前輪次結束，切換成 `Send Immediately` 則能立即中斷助理。這項偏好也能直接寫入全域設定檔 `settings.json`，修正了以往寫入該設定卻被系統忽略的問題：
```json
{"queuedMessages": "send-immediately"}
```
body.en:
When you see your assistant heading in the wrong direction during a long task, you can now speak up and stop it directly. ⟦Think of calling out to stop a helper carrying the wrong box: previously you had to wait until the entire shipment was moved to issue new instructions, but now you can interrupt immediately.⟧ You can find the `Queued Messages` option in the `/config` menu. Keeping the default `Queue` buffers follow-up messages until the current turn ends, while switching to `Send Immediately` interrupts the assistant right away. This preference can also be written directly to the global configuration file `settings.json`, fixing an issue where writing this setting previously got ignored by the system:
```json
{"queuedMessages": "send-immediately"}
```

items.original: Added the `Queued Messages` option to `/config`: keep the default `Queue` to hold follow-up messages until the current turn ends, or choose `Send Immediately` to interrupt the agent with them; it can also be set with `"queuedMessages": "send-immediately"` in `settings.json`, which was previously ignored

title.zh-TW: Linux 容器環境支援遠端控制，沒有 systemd 使用者服務管理員也能背景啟動
title.en: Remote Control Now Supported in Linux Containers, Starting in Background Without systemd User Service Manager

body.zh-TW: 當你在輕量 Docker 環境裡想要連線操作時，過去常因底層缺少自動託管機制而直接碰壁卡關。⟦彷彿在沒有自動排班系統的小型倉庫裡改由工人手動輪值，雖然當機時不會自動重啟、開機也不會自動執行，但依然能把手邊的工作順利跑起來。⟧在沒有 systemd 使用者服務管理員（替個人帳號管理背景服務的程式）的 Linux 機器上執行 `remote-control start` 時，現在會直接將常駐程式以背景行程啟動，並警告該行程當機後不會自動重啟且開機時不會自動載入。你隨時能輸入 `remote-control status` 查詢其行程識別碼（PID），需要結束時輸入 `remote-control stop` 即可將其關閉。
body.en: When you want to connect and operate inside a lightweight Docker environment, you previously hit a wall because the underlying system lacked an automated hosting mechanism. ⟦Picture running a small warehouse without an automated scheduling system by having workers take manual shifts: although it will not automatically restart on crashes or launch on boot, it still keeps your current work running smoothly.⟧ When running `remote-control start` on Linux machines without a systemd user service manager (a program that manages background services for a user account), the daemon now starts directly as a background process, warning that the process will not restart on crash or launch on boot. You can enter `remote-control status` anytime to check its process ID (PID), and enter `remote-control stop` whenever you need to shut it down.

items.original: Improved `remote-control start` on Linux machines without a systemd user service manager, such as most containers: instead of failing, it now starts the daemon as a background process and warns that it will not restart after a crash or start at boot; `remote-control status` shows its PID and `remote-control stop` shuts it down

title.zh-TW: 長對話載入更快，缺步歷程不再覆寫舊進度
title.en: Long Conversations Load Faster, and Histories with Missing Steps No Longer Overwrite Old Progress

body.zh-TW: 當你接續聊了很久的繁重工作階段，或是中途遇上當機想接回紀錄時，整個流程順暢且安心許多。⟦如同翻開厚重日記時直接跳到最新的書籤頁，不必每次都從第一頁逐字掃描，就算中間曾掉了一頁，後續記錄也絕不會錯位覆蓋。⟧重啟擁有數千步驟的對話時，命令列介面不再預先逐步掃描，載入速度明顯加快。歷程若曾因當機或寫入中斷而出現遺漏步驟，恢復時不會再隱藏最新內容，更不會讓新訊息意外覆寫舊紀錄。自動產生的對話標題現在也會將首則訊息附加的圖片與檔案納入考量，純傳截圖或檔案的請求也能擁有具體的標題。
body.en: When you resume a heavy, long-running session or reconnect to your history after a crash, the entire workflow is noticeably smoother and safer. ⟦A reader opening a thick journal jumps straight to the newest bookmarked page without scanning word-by-word from the start, ensuring later entries never misalign or overwrite old notes even if a page went missing.⟧ When restarting conversations with thousands of steps, the command-line interface no longer pre-scans step-by-step, significantly speeding up load times. If history was missing steps due to crashes or interrupted writes, resuming will no longer hide the latest content, nor will new messages accidentally overwrite old records. Auto-generated conversation titles now also factor in images and files attached to the first message, giving concrete titles to requests that only include screenshots or files.

items.original:
Improved loading long conversations: resuming a conversation with thousands of steps is noticeably faster because the CLI no longer scans every step up front
Improved automatically generated conversation titles to take images and files attached to your first message into account, so screenshot- or file-driven requests get specific titles and messages with only attachments get a title too
Fixed resuming a conversation whose history had a missing step, for example after a crash or an interrupted write, hiding the most recent steps and letting new messages overwrite them

title.zh-TW: 帳號違規遭封鎖時，登入錯誤提示附上申訴連結
title.en: Login Error Prompts Include Appeal Links When Accounts Are Blocked for Violations

body.zh-TW: 早上一開工卻被擋在門外，畫面上只寫著因違反服務條款（Terms of Service）遭到停權，常讓人不知道該去哪裡詢問。以前遇到帳號受阻只能看見失敗提示，摸不清該找誰處理；現在登入失敗的錯誤訊息裡會直接附上申訴連結，讓你能立刻點擊網址提交說明。⟦就像門禁卡突然失效時，感應機不再只發出逼逼警告聲，而是直接在螢幕上顯示管理室的服務電話與分機。⟧
body.en: Starting your morning only to find yourself locked out, with a screen stating your account has been suspended for violating the Terms of Service, often leaves you wondering where to turn. Previously, encountering a blocked account only showed a generic failure message with no clear contact point; now, login failure error messages directly include an appeal link, letting you click the URL immediately to submit an explanation. ⟦Instead of merely beeping when an access card fails, a card reader now displays the management office phone number and extension directly on its screen.⟧

items.original: Improved the sign-in error shown to accounts blocked for a Terms of Service violation, which now includes a link to submit an appeal

title.zh-TW: `--json-schema` 啟動時嚴格檢查，根層級非物件立即報錯
title.en: `--json-schema` Strictly Validated at Startup, Failing Immediately If Root Level Is Not an Object

body.zh-TW: 當你為指令傳入結構描述時，若格式有誤或檔案遺失，系統在啟動階段就會立即攔截。⟦好比海關在登機門前嚴格核對護照格式，發現拿的是白紙、寫錯代碼或缺件就當場拒絕通行，而不是放行登機後才引發混亂。⟧參數 `--json-schema` 不再將純文字、單獨型態名稱（如 `string`）或不存在的結構描述檔默默當成字串型態處理。現在只要輸入上述無效內容，或是根層級不是物件（`"type": "object"`）的結構描述，程式在啟動時就會直接輸出錯誤訊息並以結束代碼 `1` 中斷退出。
body.en: When you pass a schema to a command, the system now intercepts formatting errors or missing files right at startup. ⟦Customs officers strictly check passport formats at the boarding gate, turning away blank paper, mistyped codes, or missing documents on the spot rather than causing chaos after boarding.⟧ The `--json-schema` parameter no longer silently treats plain text, bare type names (such as `string`), or non-existent schema files as string types. Supplying any of these invalid inputs, or a schema whose root level is not an object (`"type": "object"`), now causes the program to output an error message at startup and exit immediately with exit code `1`.

items.original: Changed `--json-schema` to reject plain text, bare type names such as `string`, and missing schema files instead of silently treating them as a string schema; these inputs, and any schema whose root is not `"type": "object"`, now fail at startup with an error and exit code `1`

title.zh-TW: 輸入提示不再游標偏離，表情符號與特殊文字換行不割裂
title.en: Prompt Input Eliminates Cursor Drift, Keeping Emojis and Complex Characters Intact Across Line Wraps

body.zh-TW: 在終端機輸入特殊字元或在多重視窗中作業時，游標位置與文字折行現在能精準對齊。⟦就像使用排版工具編輯圖文，以前遇到複雜貼圖或組合文字時游標會飄到半空中、換行還會把圖案切成兩半，現在游標與字元邊界都緊緊貼合。⟧修復了在提示列輸入 ⚠️ 或 👩‍💻 等表情符號，以及天城文（Devanagari）與泰文等組合字元時游標尾端偏離的問題，特別是在 `tmux` 環境下更是如此。當文字過長自動折行時，也不會再將這類特殊字元拆散切成兩行顯示。
body.en: When entering special characters in the terminal or working across multiplexed windows, cursor positioning and text wrapping now align precisely. ⟦Like laying out text and graphics in a publishing tool where complex stickers previously floated the cursor into mid-air and line breaks sliced graphics in half, the cursor and character boundaries now fit tightly together.⟧ Fixed trailing cursor drift when entering emojis such as ⚠️ or 👩‍💻, as well as combining characters like Devanagari and Thai in the prompt line, especially inside `tmux` environments. When long text wraps automatically, it will also no longer split these special characters across two lines.

items.original: Fixed the prompt cursor drifting away from the end of the text after emoji such as ⚠️ or 👩‍💻, or scripts with combining marks such as Devanagari and Thai, especially inside `tmux`, and fixed prompt wrapping splitting such characters across two lines

title.zh-TW: 檢視管線裝置與損毀影音不再卡死，事前攔截並清楚提示
title.en: Inspecting Pipe Devices and Corrupted Media No Longer Hangs, Intercepting Early with Clear Prompts

body.zh-TW: 當助理嘗試讀取特殊系統檔案或不完整的影音錄影時，對話不會再陷入無止境的等待或報錯。⟦宛如播放器遇到未下載完成的影片或特殊資料通道時直接提示檔案損毀，而不是整台機器當機轉圈圈。⟧以前助理若嘗試檢視管線（pipe）、通訊端或裝置檔等特殊檔案，流程很容易直接卡死。檢視未錄製完整的 MP4、MOV 或 M4A 影音檔時，對話也會陷入無效引數（`INVALID_ARGUMENT`）錯誤而無法繼續。現在遇到這兩類檔案時，系統會在讀取前直接攔截並給出明確的提示訊息。
body.en: When the assistant attempts to read special system files or incomplete audiovisual recordings, conversations no longer get trapped in endless waiting or error states. ⟦A media player encountering an incomplete video download or a special data stream alerts you to file corruption directly instead of freezing the entire machine with a spinning wheel.⟧ Previously, if the assistant tried to inspect special files such as pipes, sockets, or device files, the process easily hung completely. Inspecting incompletely recorded MP4, MOV, or M4A media files also threw `INVALID_ARGUMENT` errors that blocked the conversation from continuing. When encountering either type of file, the system now intercepts before reading and provides a clear prompt.

items.original: Fixed the agent hanging when it tried to view a pipe, socket, or device file, and a conversation getting stuck with `INVALID_ARGUMENT` errors after the agent viewed a truncated MP4, MOV, or M4A recording; both are now rejected up front with a clear message

title.zh-TW: 遇到模型限流聰明等待，額度耗盡立刻停手
title.en: Smarter Retry Delays on Rate Limits, Immediate Stop When Quota Exhausted

body.zh-TW: 若是頻繁發問而觸發了雲端模型的呼叫頻率限制，命令列工具現在會更聰明地處理重新嘗試的時間。以前只要遇到 API（程式與雲端模型溝通的管道）回傳需要稍候重試，工具一律死板地固定等待五秒。現在它會完全照著伺服器要求的秒數等待。如果伺服器要求等待超過三十秒，或是回報每日額度與帳單上限已滿，工具便會立刻停止執行，不再盲目重試。⟦跟到熱門餐廳抽號碼牌一樣，以前不管店家告知要等多久，你都每隔五秒就上前敲一次門；現在店家說等幾秒就精確等幾秒，若店家告知要等超過三十秒或當日名額已滿，則會立刻轉身離開不再徒勞敲門。⟧
body.en: If frequent prompts trigger cloud model rate limits, the command-line tool now handles retry delays more intelligently. Previously, whenever the API returned a retry-after response, the tool rigidly waited for a fixed five seconds. Now, it waits for the exact number of seconds requested by the server. If the server requests a delay of more than thirty seconds, or reports that the daily quota or billing limit is exhausted, the tool stops immediately instead of retrying blindly. ⟦Think of taking a number at a popular restaurant: in the past, no matter how long the staff told you to wait, you knocked on the door every five seconds; now you wait for the exact duration requested, and if they tell you the wait exceeds thirty seconds or that daily capacity is full, you turn away immediately without knocking in vain.⟧

items.original: Improved rate-limit handling when the model API returns a retry delay: the CLI now waits the delay the server asks for instead of a fixed 5 seconds, and stops right away instead of retrying when the delay is longer than 30 seconds or the quota is a daily or billing cap

title.zh-TW: 提升對話畫面繪製效能，捲動與運作時更省資源
title.en: Improved Chat Screen Rendering Performance for Lower Resource Usage While Scrolling

body.zh-TW: 在快速捲動落落長的對話紀錄、或看著代理人（代你執行任務的 AI）忙碌時，介面操作現在感覺更加輕快。對話畫面在重新繪製時的效能獲得了改善。以前每當畫面快速重繪，電腦的處理器（負責執行所有運算的核心硬體）使用率容易飆高，記憶體也會頻繁配置與釋放。現在無論是快速捲動視窗還是等待代理人即時輸出，都能有效減少運算資源耗損與記憶體負擔。⟦彷彿速寫畫家連畫好幾頁，以前很快就累了，畫紙也用得快；現在畫同樣多頁，力氣與畫紙都省下不少。⟧
body.en: When quickly scrolling through lengthy conversation histories or watching an agent work, UI interactions now feel significantly snappier. Redrawing performance for the conversation screen has been improved. Previously, rapid screen repaints often spiked CPU usage and caused frequent memory allocations and releases. Now, whether scrolling quickly through the window or waiting for real-time agent output, compute overhead and memory pressure are both substantially reduced. ⟦Picture a sketch artist drawing several pages in a row: in the past, the artist quickly grew tired and burned through paper; now, drawing that same number of pages takes far less effort and saves plenty of paper.⟧

items.original: Improved rendering efficiency, cutting CPU use and memory churn while the conversation view redraws, such as during fast scrolling or while the agent is working

title.zh-TW: 產物檢視器按鍵提示更明確，切換模式一目了然
title.en: Clearer Key Hints in the Artifact Viewer for Intuitive Mode Toggling

body.zh-TW: 想要預覽 AI 生成的圖表或公式等產物（獨立生成的圖表、公式或文件檔案）時，底部切換顯示模式的提示變得更直覺了。以前畫面上的 `m` 按鍵提示只寫 `toggle ASCII` 或 `toggle raw`，讓人難以預期切換後的畫面。現在提示文字會直接寫出內容種類與目標模式，例如清楚標示 `diagram ASCII`、`diagram source` 或是 `math image`。⟦好比相機上的功能轉盤，以前上面的標籤只寫著模糊的切換，轉過去才知道會變成什麼；現在清楚標示人像或夜景，按下去前就能明確知道切換後的樣貌。⟧
body.en: When previewing AI-generated artifacts such as standalone diagrams, formulas, or document files, the bottom hint for toggling display modes is now much more intuitive. Previously, the on-screen `m` key hint only displayed `toggle ASCII` or `toggle raw`, making it hard to anticipate what the screen would switch to. Now, the prompt text explicitly shows the content type and target mode, clearly indicating options like `diagram ASCII`, `diagram source`, or `math image`. ⟦Like a mode dial on a camera where labels previously showed a vague toggle so you only discovered the outcome after turning it, the dial now clearly marks portrait or night scene so you know the exact result before switching.⟧

items.original: Improved the artifact viewer's `m` hint to name the content and the mode it switches to, such as `diagram ASCII`, `diagram source`, or `math image`, instead of `toggle ASCII` or `toggle raw`

title.zh-TW: 窄終端機視窗文字不再被截斷，長行與標籤自動排版
title.en: Text No Longer Truncated in Narrow Terminal Windows with Auto-Wrapping for Long Lines and Tabs

body.zh-TW: 把終端機視窗縮小到約 40 欄寬的狹窄寬度時，各個功能面板的文字再也不會因為超出邊界而被裁切。以前在工作區信任對話框、`/help` 說明面板，以及登入與 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）驗證畫面中，長文字容易直接消失在螢幕邊緣。現在這些畫面中的長行文字與操作導引提示都會自動折行顯示，`/help` 的分頁標籤列也會自動緊縮排版以完整容納，排版截斷問題已經修好。
body.en: When shrinking a terminal window down to a narrow width of around 40 columns, text in various panels is no longer clipped by boundary overflows. Previously, in workspace trust dialogs, the `/help` panel, and login or MCP authentication screens, long text frequently disappeared off the edge of the screen. Now, long lines and guidance prompts across these screens wrap automatically, and the tab bar in `/help` compresses its layout to fit completely, fixing text truncation issues.

items.original: Fixed the workspace trust dialog, the `/help` panel, and the sign-in and MCP authentication screens clipping text on narrow terminals of around 40 columns; long lines and navigation hints now wrap, and the `/help` tab bar compacts to fit

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕捲動效能升級，長對話與檢視器不再卡頓
title.en: Smoother Full-Screen Scrolling Eliminates Stutter in Long Chats and Artifact Viewer

body.zh-TW: 當你在全螢幕模式下翻閱篇幅很長的對話紀錄，或是打開產出物檢視器查閱內容時，快速滑動滾輪與觸控板變得十分滑順。以前手指快速滾動時，每一次細微的滾輪訊號都會立即觸發畫面重新繪製，不僅容易造成畫面卡頓，還會佔用大量處理器（CPU，電腦負責運算的核心）資源。現在系統會先將短時間內連續觸發的滑動事件合併整理，再一次性更新畫面，既降低了運算負擔，也消除了操作延遲。⟦如同收發室把同一時間寄達的零散信件整批捆好一次遞交，不必每來一張明信片就專程跑一趟辦公室。⟧
body.en: Rapid scrolling with a mouse wheel or trackpad is now much smoother when browsing lengthy conversation histories or inspecting content in the artifact viewer in full-screen mode. Previously, every tiny scroll event triggered an immediate screen redraw during fast scrolling, which caused visual stutter and consumed heavy CPU resources. The system now batches scroll events triggered in rapid succession before updating the screen all at once, reducing computational overhead and eliminating lag. ⟦Picture a mailroom bundling scattered letters that arrive at the same time into a single delivery, rather than running to an office for every individual postcard.⟧

items.original: Improved scrolling in the full-screen view: bursts of mouse-wheel or trackpad events are now coalesced before redrawing, which cuts CPU use and reduces scroll lag in long conversations and the artifact viewer

title.zh-TW: 額度或預算耗盡立即停損，不再空等數分鐘重試
title.en: Immediate Fail-Fast on Exhausted Quota or Budget Without Minutes of Retrying

body.zh-TW: 使用金鑰 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 進行操作時，一旦帳戶額度見底，系統會立即中斷並回報，不再讓你乾等。以前只要遇到每日配額（quota，平台允許呼叫的使用上限）耗盡、專案或帳單達到支出上限，或是預付餘額扣光，程式仍會花費數分鐘持續重試不可能成功的連線。現在遇到這類確定無法解決的狀況會立刻中止工作階段。至於每分鐘呼叫次數超標這類短暫限制，仍會自動重試。⟦好比去自動販賣機買飲料，發現卡片餘額不足時機器會立刻提示餘額為零，而不是反覆吞吐卡片空轉好幾分鐘。⟧
body.en: When operating with `GEMINI_API_KEY`, the system now halts immediately and reports the error once your account quota is exhausted, sparing you from waiting idly. Previously, when hitting daily quotas, project or billing spend limits, or running out of prepaid credits, the application would still spend several minutes retrying connections that could not possibly succeed. The session now terminates immediately upon encountering these permanently unresolvable conditions. Transient restrictions such as exceeding rate limits per minute will still be retried automatically. ⟦A vending machine immediately alerts you to a zero balance when your card lacks sufficient funds, rather than repeatedly ejecting and swallowing the card for minutes.⟧

items.original: Improved `GEMINI_API_KEY` sessions to stop immediately when the Gemini API reports an exhausted daily quota, a project or billing-account spend cap, or depleted prepaid credits, instead of spending several minutes on retries that cannot succeed; short-lived per-minute rate limits are still retried

title.zh-TW: 重新接續長對話瞬間載入，跳過重複動畫不再卡頓
title.en: Instant Resumption for Long Sessions Skips Replay Animations Without Lag

body.zh-TW: 當你打開先前篇幅很長的工作階段繼續提問時，畫面載入的速度變得俐落許多。以前在 `medium` 或 `low` 的詳細程度（verbosity，決定畫面要印出多少除錯與執行細節的設定）下恢復對話時，系統需要花上數秒重播所有歷史紀錄，造成操作延遲。現在先前執行完畢的工具會直接顯示為完成狀態，省去逐條重播動畫的時間。在載入過程中敲擊鍵盤，也不會再重新整理只載入到一半的對話紀錄。⟦就像翻開已寫好的會議紀錄，大家能直接從結論處接著討論，不必把每位發言者的發言逐字重唸一遍。⟧
body.en: Loading feels much crisper when reopening a lengthy prior session to continue asking questions. Previously, resuming a conversation under `medium` or `low` verbosity required several seconds to replay entire histories, causing UI lag. Previously completed tools now render directly in their finished state, skipping sequential animation replays. Typing on the keyboard during loading also no longer refreshes a conversation history that has only partially loaded. ⟦Think of opening completed meeting minutes where everyone resumes discussion directly from the conclusion, without reading every attendee's remarks aloud word for word.⟧

items.original: Fixed resuming a long conversation in `medium` or `low` verbosity taking many seconds and lagging while history replayed: earlier tool groups now appear already finished instead of each re-animating, and keys pressed during the replay no longer refresh a half-loaded transcript

title.zh-TW: 終端機多工器標題不再亂碼，修復圖片探測干擾
title.en: Terminal Multiplexer Titles Preserved Without Mojibake From Graphics Probing

body.zh-TW: 在多窗格環境下啟動工具時，終端機與分頁的名稱終於能正常保留。以前在 GNU `screen`、`tmux`（包含 iTerm2 的 `tmux -CC` 分頁）或 Zellij 等環境中開啓命令列時，標題每次都會被改成 `Ga=q,f=32,...` 這類奇怪的字串。這是因為系統啟動時會發送圖片支援的探測訊號，因而干擾了終端機多工器（將終端視窗分割成多個獨立工作區的工具）。現在程式不再主動向多工器發送圖片探測指令。若你確定需要開啟圖片顯示，依然可透過設定 `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty` 強制啟用。⟦彷彿廣播系統取消了開場時刺耳的測試音，螢幕面板上的節目名稱再也不會被測試訊號給干擾覆蓋。⟧
body.en: Terminal and tab titles are now properly preserved when launching tools in multi-pane environments. Previously, opening the command line under GNU `screen`, `tmux` (including iTerm2 `tmux -CC` tabs), or Zellij altered window titles to strange strings like `Ga=q,f=32,...`. This occurred because the startup sequence sent graphics support probes, which interfered with terminal multiplexers. The program no longer sends graphics probes to multiplexers by default. If you still need image rendering, you can force it on by setting `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty`. ⟦Like a broadcast system silencing its harsh opening test tone, the show title on the display panel is no longer scrambled by test signals.⟧

items.original: Fixed the terminal or tab title changing to a string like `Ga=q,f=32,...` every time the CLI starts inside GNU `screen`, `tmux` (including iTerm2 `tmux -CC` tabs), or Zellij; the CLI no longer sends its image-support probe through a multiplexer, and `CLI_GRAPHICS=kitty` still forces image mode

title.zh-TW: Vim 模式多項修正，支援中文字元搜尋與選取復原
title.en: Multiple Vim Mode Fixes Support Non-ASCII Character Search and Selection Undo

body.zh-TW: 偏好使用 Vim 模式編輯指令與文字的讀者，現在輸入非英文字元或選取段落時順手許多。以前在 `r`、`f`、`F`、`t` 與 `T` 指令後輸入 `é` 或 `中` 等非 ASCII 字元（非英文字母與標準符號的文字）時會被直接忽略。在可視模式（Visual mode，反白選取文字的模式）下使用 `fv` 與 `fV` 會意外跳出選取，無法順利延伸範圍。當執行 `D`、`C` 或可視狀態下的 `~`、`u`、`U` 但沒有變動文字時，以前還會多記一筆空白復原紀錄並清空重做歷程。現在這些編輯問題都已修正完畢。⟦宛如操作高階文書軟體，跳躍搜尋中文字能精確定位，反白選取時不會無故中斷，就算誤觸沒有作用的按鍵也不會清空復原歷程。⟧
body.en: Editing commands and text in Vim mode is now significantly smoother when typing non-English characters or selecting blocks. Previously, non-ASCII characters such as `é` or `中` were silently ignored after `r`, `f`, `F`, `t`, and `T` commands. Using `fv` and `fV` in Visual mode inadvertently exited the selection instead of extending the range. Furthermore, executing `D`, `C`, or Visual mode `~`, `u`, and `U` without modifying text recorded an empty undo entry and wiped the redo history. All of these editing glitches have now been resolved. ⟦Much like working in an advanced text editor, jumping to Chinese characters lands accurately, highlighting text does not abruptly cancel, and hitting ineffective keys will not wipe your redo history.⟧

items.original: Fixed Vim mode ignoring non-ASCII characters such as `é` or `中` after `r`, `f`, `F`, `t` and `T`, `fv` and `fV` in Visual mode leaving Visual mode instead of extending the selection, and `D`, `C`, or Visual `~`/`u`/`U` recording an empty undo step and clearing redo history when they changed nothing

title.zh-TW: 接回舊對話與狀態列即時提醒，快取過期成本一目了然
title.en: Resuming Old Conversations with Real-Time Status Line Alerts Makes Cache Expiration Costs Clear

body.zh-TW: 當你暫停工作後想接續先前任務，常因快取（暫存計算結果的機制）過期而重送大量資料。開啟進度管家後，只要以 `/resume`、`--resume` 或 `--continue` 接回過期且脈絡達 5 萬 token（AI 計費的文字單位）的對話，Claude Code 會在輸入首句前顯示一行提示，列出閒置時間、預估重送的 token 數並建議先執行 `/compact`。此提示僅自己可見且不計入脈絡，需 2.1.251 以上版本且下次啟動 usage 自動套用。狀態列在倒數結束後也不再留白，到期當下會即時重畫，顯示如 `cold·re-cache 180k` 的提示，表示下一則訊息約有 18 萬 token 要重新快取。⟦如同退房時櫃檯即時試算加時費用，以前超時往往結帳才發現驚人帳單，現在一到超時點就主動亮出補收標準，讓你能提前評估是否精簡內容。⟧
body.en: When resuming previous tasks after taking a break, users often resend large amounts of data due to expired caches. With Progress Manager enabled, whenever you resume an expired conversation with at least 50k tokens of context using `/resume`, `--resume`, or `--continue`, Claude Code displays a single-line notice before you enter your first prompt. This notice details the idle duration and the estimated number of tokens to resend, while suggesting that you run `/compact` first. Visible only to you, this prompt is excluded from context, requires version 2.1.251 or later, and applies automatically the next time usage launches. The status line also no longer goes blank when the countdown ends. Instead, it redraws immediately upon expiration to show prompts like `cold·re-cache 180k`, indicating that the next message will re-cache approximately 180k tokens. ⟦Picture a hotel front desk calculating overtime charges the moment checkout passes: instead of discovering a surprise bill at final settlement, you immediately see the extra fees and can decide in advance whether to trim your stay.⟧

items.original:
**Resuming a stale conversation now tells you what it will cost.** When Progress Concierge is on and you `/resume` (or `--resume` / `--continue`) a conversation whose prompt cache has expired and whose context is at least 50k tokens, Claude Code shows a one-line warning before your first message: how long it sat idle, roughly how many tokens the next message re-sends, and a suggestion to `/compact` first. Only you see it; it is never added to Claude's context. Needs Claude Code 2.1.251 or newer. Existing installs pick up the new trigger automatically the next time usage starts.
**The status line now says what a cold cache will cost.** Once the prompt cache countdown runs out, the segment switches to how many tokens the next message will re-cache (for example `cold·re-cache 180k`) instead of going blank. Claude Code redraws the status line the moment the cache expires, so no refresh interval is needed.

title.zh-TW: 額度快用完改播專屬短音，告急提醒更具辨識度
title.en: Distinct Chimes for Dwindling Quotas Make Low-Quota Alerts Instantly Recognizable

body.zh-TW: 埋頭趕工或專注思考時，如果沒有時常緊盯著用量面板，額度（特定週期內可使用的調用配額上限）見底的瞬間往往讓人猝不及防。現在系統調整了通知音效，當額度快用完或已經用完時，會改播 usage 自製的兩聲「uh-oh」簡短警示音，讓你光聽聲音就能分辨用量告急。至於額度恢復時的通知，則繼續維持播放系統預設的提示音，避免干擾既有的使用習慣。⟦洗衣機遇到排水故障時用短促警示，洗好衣服則播放一般完成音；現在額度告急有專屬短音，額度恢復仍是系統預設音，光聽就能分辨。⟧
body.en: When rushing through work or deep in thought, running out of quota without watching the usage popover can easily catch you off guard. The system has now updated its notification sounds. Whenever quota is running low or fully exhausted, usage plays a custom two-tone "uh-oh" short alert, letting you recognize the urgent status by sound alone. Notifications for quota recovery continue to play the default system chime, preserving your established workflow habits. ⟦A washing machine beeps with a sharp warning when drainage fails but plays a standard completion chime when the cycle finishes smoothly. In the same way, quota exhaustion now triggers a dedicated short tone while recovery uses the default system sound, making them distinguishable by ear alone.⟧

items.original: Quota warning and quota-depleted notifications now play a short two-note "uh-oh" alert sound made for usage. The quota-restored notification keeps the system default sound.

title.zh-TW: 修正子代理輸出少算問題，歷史快取自動重新結算
title.en: Fixing Undercounted Subagent Outputs and Automatically Recalculating Historical Caches

body.zh-TW: 習慣呼叫多個背景助手平行處理繁重任務的使用者，過去看到的用量統計可能嚴重失真。先前在串流（答案一邊生成一邊逐字傳輸的輸出方式）處理時，Claude Code 會把同一請求多次寫入日誌，導致解析器只抓到第一行，使子代理的輸出用量少算約 86%。例如在某台機器上的 17 個子代理日誌中，原本僅記錄到 23,327 個輸出 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位），修正後改取每筆請求的最大值，實際數值應為 165,395。這項問題只影響子代理，主對話日誌完全不受影響；更新後歷史快取與年度快取會自動重算一次，但日誌已遭刪除的日期則維持封存數字無法補正。⟦好比收銀機結帳時印出整串明細，以前系統只抓取了剛開始印出的第一行小計，導致整筆交易總額嚴重短少；現在改以最終印出的加總金額為準，歷史紀錄重新結算後用量數字終於回歸真實。⟧
body.en: Users accustomed to spawning multiple background assistants for parallel tasks may have previously seen severely skewed usage statistics. During streaming responses, Claude Code wrote the same request to logs multiple times. This caused the parser to capture only the first line, undercounting subagent output usage by about 86%. For example, across 17 subagent logs on one machine, only 23,327 output tokens were initially recorded; after switching to taking the maximum value per request, the actual count was 165,395. This issue affected only subagents, leaving main session logs completely untouched. After the update, historical and annual caches are automatically recalculated once, though dates whose logs were deleted remain archived and cannot be retroactively fixed. ⟦Think of a cash register printing a long receipt where the system previously captured only the first line of subtotal, causing the recorded total to fall drastically short. By taking the final printed sum instead, historical records are recalculated and usage numbers reflect reality at last.⟧

items.original: **Claude subagent output was undercounted by about 86%.** Claude Code writes each subagent request to its transcript several times while it streams, and `output_tokens` only reaches its final value on the last line. Both Claude parsers kept the first line, so on one machine 17 subagent transcripts counted 23,327 output tokens instead of 165,395. They now keep the largest value for each request. Main-conversation transcripts were not affected. The history and yearly caches are rebuilt once; days whose transcripts were already deleted keep their archived totals and cannot be corrected.

title.zh-TW: 離線備用價目表補上 Sonnet 5.5，名稱顯示不再截斷
title.en: Offline Fallback Pricing Adds Sonnet 5.5 and Fixes Truncated Model Names

body.zh-TW: 遇到網路斷線或離線環境工作時，最怕計費工具因連不上伺服器而無法正確計算新型號的花費。現在離線備援（主要機制失效時接手的後備清單）價目表正式補上了新模型資料，完整納入 `claude-sonnet-5-5` 的費率。以前當下載的線上價目表過期時，這款模型的用量會被誤算為 0 美元；現在即使離線也能依正確標準計價，終端機表格中也會顯示為清晰的「Sonnet 5.5」，不再出現被截斷的模型識別碼。⟦彷彿隨身攜帶的紙本價目表補齊了最新熱門品項，以前網路斷線時查不到新餐點價格會直接被當成免費招待，現在備援清單完整對齊，就算離線結算也不會漏算費用。⟧
body.en: When working offline or during network outages, cost tracking tools often fail to price new models accurately without server access. The offline fallback pricing table now officially incorporates new model data, fully including rates for `claude-sonnet-5-5`. Previously, when the downloaded online pricing expired, usage for this model was miscalculated as $0. ## Security

Four security vulnerabilities have been identified, and fixed, in this release. Users are advised to update gh to version `v2.102.0` as soon as possible.

`gh release download`, `gh run download`, `gh repo read-file --output`, and `gh attestation download` could write remote content to an unintended local file when the destination contained symbolic links.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-39wj-f2f4-978v for more information.

`gh attestation verify` compared the `--source-ref` value case-insensitively, so an attestation built from a branch whose name differs only in case could satisfy a policy that named a different branch.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-4mq3-hpgx-9cx8 for more information.

Interactive `gh skill search` passed repository paths from search results to `gh skill install` without an option separator, so a search result could inject installer options and change where skill files were written.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-qcwj-mr2r-2cx7 for more information.

`gh attestation verify` matched the `--signer-workflow` value against only the start of the signing certificate's identity, so an attestation signed by a different workflow in the pinned repository could pass verification when its path began with the pinned value.

See https://github.com/cli/cli/security/advisories/GHSA-wjmr-j3rp-mh2g for more information.

title.zh-TW: Linux 上用 APT 或 RPM 裝的 gh 要認新金鑰
title.en: gh installed via APT or RPM on Linux needs the new signing key

body.zh-TW: 你在 Linux 上更新 `gh`，卻突然裝不起來、報簽章驗證失敗？多半是金鑰換了。GitHub CLI 的 APT 與 RPM 套件庫（Linux 下載與更新軟體的官方來源），連同個別的 RPM 套件檔，現在只用新的 PGP 金鑰簽署，指紋是 `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`。如果你在 2026 年 4 月 8 日前從官方 APT 或 RPM 套件庫裝了 `gh`，又還沒更新金鑰圈（電腦裡記著哪些簽章可以信任的清單），安裝或更新就可能失敗。⟦就像快遞改用新封條，你家警衛只認得舊封條，包裹就會被擋在門外，得先把新封條的樣子告訴警衛。⟧照官方的 PGP 簽章金鑰輪換說明檢查、更新金鑰圈就能解決。用 Windows、macOS，或透過 Homebrew、GitHub Releases、其他套件管理器、原始碼安裝的人不受影響。
body.en: Updating `gh` on Linux and suddenly getting a signature verification failure? The signing key most likely changed. GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key, fingerprint `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`. If you installed `gh` from the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026 and haven't refreshed your keyring, installs and updates may fail. ⟦It's like a courier switching to a new seal: your building's guard only knows the old one, so packages get turned away until you show the guard what the new seal looks like.⟧ Follow the official PGP signing key rotation guidance to check and update your keyring. Users on Windows or macOS, and anyone who installed through Homebrew, GitHub Releases, another package manager, or from source, are not affected.

items.original:
## Linux package repository signing key rotation

GitHub CLI's APT and RPM repositories, along with individual RPM packages, are now signed only with the new PGP key (fingerprint: `7F38BBB59D064DBCB3D84D725612B36462313325`)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Linux users who installed `gh` from the official APT or RPM repositories before April 8, 2026, and have not refreshed their keyring, may now see package installation or update failures. Follow the [PGP signing key rotation guidance](https://github.com/cli/cli/issues/13118) to check and update your keyring. Users on Windows or macOS, and users who installed `gh` through Homebrew, GitHub Releases, another package manager, or from source, are not affected.

title.zh-TW: gh 登入時自動幫你複製驗證碼

body.zh-TW:
用 `gh auth login` 登入 GitHub，或用 `gh auth refresh` 更新權限時，畫面會給你一組 OAuth 裝置代碼（要貼到瀏覽器授權頁、證明是你本人在登入的短碼）。以前你得自己反白、複製，再切到瀏覽器貼上；現在這兩個指令預設會直接把代碼放進剪貼簿，切過去按貼上就好。⟦櫃檯人員直接把號碼牌塞到你手上，你就不必再拿筆抄一次號碼。⟧不想要這個行為，可以用下面這行永久關掉：

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

某一次執行時如果你另外指定了剪貼簿選項，那一次就照你指定的來。
body.en:
When you sign in with `gh auth login` or refresh permissions with `gh auth refresh`, the screen gives you an OAuth device code to paste into the browser's authorization page. You used to highlight it, copy it, then switch to the browser and paste. Now both commands put the code on your clipboard by default, so you just switch over and paste. ⟦Think of a service desk where the clerk hands you the ticket instead of making you copy the number down with a pen.⟧ To turn this off for good, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

If you pass an explicit clipboard option on a single run, that run follows your choice.

items.original:
## Copy authentication codes to the clipboard by default

`gh auth login` and `gh auth refresh` now copy OAuth device codes to the clipboard by default, saving a manual copy step during authentication.

To persistently opt out, run:

```shell
gh config set clipboard disabled
```

Explicit clipboard options still take precedence for an individual invocation.

title.zh-TW: GitHub API 流量支援自訂閘道，身分驗證與網址維持直連
title.en: GitHub API Traffic Supports Custom Gateways, While Authentication and URLs Remain Direct

body.zh-TW:
企業若需要稽核或集中管控網路流量，現在可以透過個別主機的 `api_host` 設定，將 GitHub API 請求導向自訂閘道（gateway，把流量轉去另一個位址再送出的中繼點）。這項改動只會轉發 API 呼叫，登入身分驗證、Git 遠端儲存庫操作與瀏覽器開啟網址仍會直接連線至原始主機。此功能目前仍處於實驗階段，且不是安全邊界，部分請求可能依然會送往原始主機。

```
# 設定將 github.com 的 API 流量轉發至自訂閘道
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# 查詢特定主機目前設定的 API 閘道位址
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦這就像公司設立的公務收發室，員工採購與查詢資料等業務公文統一由專屬窗口轉交處理，但員工出勤打卡、私人包裹寄送與親自拜訪仍直接走大樓正門。⟧
body.en:
Organizations that need to audit or centrally manage network traffic can now route GitHub API requests to a custom gateway via the per-host `api_host` setting. This change only forwards API calls; login authentication, Git remote repository operations, and browser-opened URLs still connect directly to the original host. This feature is currently experimental and is not a security boundary, so some requests may still reach the original host.

```
# Set up forwarding API traffic for github.com to a custom gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Query the currently configured API gateway address for a specific host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦This is like a company mailroom for official business, where business documents such as procurement requests and data inquiries are routed through a dedicated counter, while employee clock-ins, personal parcel deliveries, and in-person visits still go directly through the building's main entrance.⟧

items.original:
## Experimental: Route GitHub API traffic through a custom host

Organizations can now route a GitHub host's API traffic through a gateway using the new per-host `api_host` configuration:

```shell
# Route API traffic for github.com through a gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Read the configured API host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

The original host remains in use for authentication, Git remotes, and browser URLs.

> [!NOTE]
> `api_host` is experimental and is not a security boundary. Requests may still reach the original host.
